subject.title: fix(auth): stop Claude CLI runs from using expired selected OAuth tokens

question: Should an explicitly selected Claude CLI OAuth profile remain a strict account boundary—failing with re-authentication when it cannot materialize—or should existing installations retain any sibling-profile/native-login fallback?
rationale: The patch deliberately changes observable upgrade behavior to prevent account substitution and stale-token forwarding. Source-level tests can verify either policy, but cannot decide the long-term multi-account product contract.

options.title: Keep strict selected-profile behavior
options.body: Require the exact selected profile to refresh or resolve, then fail before Claude starts with the targeted re-authentication command when it cannot.

options.title: Preserve fallback behavior
options.body: Retain the prior fallback for selected-profile failures and add explicit safeguards that prevent forwarding an expired descriptor, accepting the account-selection ambiguity.

recommendation.title: Keep strict selected-profile behavior
recommendation.body: Require the exact selected profile to refresh or resolve, then fail before Claude starts with the targeted re-authentication command when it cannot.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged selected-profile implementation established the authority and forwarding contract that this repair modifies.
